title: Elvis Starr's memoir tape about meeting Ransone in the White House

tellings.quote: '70s. Like there's a tape of him saying like I met Valerie Ransone in the White House.

plain: A researcher who goes unnamed, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, says there is a tape from the 1970s on which a man named Elvis Starr dictates his memoirs. On that tape, the researcher says, Starr says he met a person named Valerie Ransone in the White House. The guest raises it as a recorded clue linking that person to the highest levels of government.
